description: This Java class 'AclModifiedStrategy' handles the 'AclModified' event within a persistence strategy, specifically updating access control list permissions on a 'ThingBuilder' object.

classes.name: AclModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends 'AbstractThingEventStrategy' to provide specific handling for 'AclModified' events. It updates permissions in the context of a 'ThingBuilder'.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply an 'AclModified' event to a 'ThingBuilder', clearing existing permissions and setting new ones based on the event.
